caption: The drawing displays a rectangular woven textile sample with an intricate geometric pattern. The design features a combination of dark blue, light blue, and beige colors. The pattern is made up of various repeating rectangular and square sections, each containing different motifs such as checks, stripes, zigzags, and small block formations. The arrangement includes horizontal and vertical bands, as well as symmetric arrangements of crosses and diamond shapes. The textile sample is centered on a plain, off-white background with a visible border around it. There is a small circular mark with text near the bottom right corner of the textile, and some handwritten numbers and notations are present in the lower right margin of the background.
title: Coverlet
